description: We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers an annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your experience and commitment to exceptional patient care. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) to ensure the highest standards of clinical oversight and resident well-being.The Assistant Director of Nursing will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality care to residents. You will contribute to staff development, maintain regulatory compliance, and foster a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled nursing leader to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license is preferred and highly valued for this role.
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with demonstrated leadership or supervisory responsibilities.
Experience working within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care environment.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Excellent clinical assessment, organizational, and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
